title: time cutoffs --strategy fanout against union on MGnify recruits
body: There is no usable cost model. nail's and mmseqs' runtimes do not scale linearly in target size, so estimating either arm by a per-comparison rate is wrong and any crossover derived that way is not to be trusted. Measured so far: fanout has a per-invocation floor of about 0.65 s seen on a four-family toy; the recruits come to 20,795 families, mean 5,427, max 221,046, 1.13e8 pairs, and the distinct-sequence count union scales with is not recorded. union is clearly right at SwissProt scale, where the pool caps near 570k; for MGnify it is unproven either way. --strategy auto stays unimplemented until this is measured; a rule of thumb is not a model.
